items.exampleEn: The two sisters ended their long argument with an embrace.
items.exampleZh: 兩姊妹用一個擁抱結束了長時間的爭吵。

items.exampleEn: He is sensitive and gets upset easily.
Only the elite of the sport can compete in the final.
items.exampleZh: 只有這項運動的菁英能參加決賽。

items.exampleEn: Please close the door gently; the baby is asleep.
items.exampleZh: 請輕輕關門，寶寶睡著了。

items.exampleEn: Our dog is friendly with everyone, even strangers.
items.exampleZh: 我們的狗對每個人都很友善，連陌生人也是。

items.exampleEn: I didn't mean to cause offense with my joke.
items.exampleZh: 我開那個玩笑不是有意冒犯。

items.exampleEn: I wanted to ask her out, but I lost my nerve.
items.exampleZh: 我想約她出去，但臨陣退縮了。

items.exampleEn: The modest winner thanked her coach and teammates first.
items.exampleZh: 那位謙虛的冠軍先感謝了她的教練和隊友。

items.sentenceEn: Teachers need to be sensitive to the needs of each student.
items.sentenceZh: 老師需要體察每位學生的需求。

items.audioEn: The mother held the crying child in a long embrace until he calmed down.
items.audioZh: 媽媽緊緊抱著哭泣的孩子，直到他平靜下來。

items.sentenceEn: Their embrace at the train station lasted almost a minute.
items.sentenceZh: 他們在火車站擁抱了將近一分鐘。

items.sentenceEn: No offense, but I think your plan needs more work.
items.sentenceZh: 無意冒犯，但我覺得你的計畫還需要再加強。

items.stemEn: When I praised her painting, she just gave a ____ smile and said, 'It's nothing special.'
items.stemZh: 我稱讚她的畫時，她只是謙虛地笑了笑，說：「沒什麼特別的。」

items.stemEn: It takes a lot of ____ to tell your boss that you disagree.
items.stemZh: 要告訴老闆你不同意，需要很大的勇氣。

items.passageEn: When our new colleague, Tara, joined the team, she seemed very modest. She rarely talked about herself, even though she had trained with an elite group of designers in Milan. Some people thought she was shy, but she was simply thoughtful and sensitive to other people's feelings. During her first big meeting, a manager criticized her design rudely. Instead of taking offense, Tara gently explained her ideas. Everyone was impressed by her nerve. After the meeting, the manager said sorry, and Tara accepted with a friendly smile. Now she is one of the most popular members of our team.
items.passageZh: 新同事 Tara 剛加入團隊時，看起來非常謙虛。她很少談論自己，雖然她曾在米蘭和一群頂尖設計師一起受訓。有些人以為她很害羞，其實她只是很體貼，能體察別人的感受。在她第一次參加的大型會議上，一位經理很無禮地批評她的設計。Tara 沒有覺得被冒犯，而是溫和地解釋她的想法。大家都很佩服她的膽量。會後那位經理向她道歉，Tara 也帶著友善的微笑接受了。現在她是我們團隊裡最受歡迎的成員之一。

options: 大學時設計系的同學們
附近大學裡的幾位教授們

questions.questionZh: 經理無禮地批評時，Tara 怎麼做？
options: 會後立刻跑去向老闆抱怨

items.promptZh: 這家店的店員都很友善。
referenceEn: The staff in this shop are very friendly.
This shop has very friendly staff.
rubricZh: friendly 表示「友善的」，可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 are friendly、friendly staff）

items.promptZh: 他們一家人住在一間樸素的小房子裡。
referenceEn: The family lives in a modest little house.
They live in a small, modest house.
rubricZh: modest 這裡表示「樸素的、不起眼的」，放名詞前（例如 a modest house 等）
「一家人」可寫，例如 the family、they 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 live、lived 等）
